prompts: Remember the little archery games of the Windows 95 days? We want the first level of one, our own, in {WS}/game/index.html, a single file. An archer you aim with the mouse, pulling the bow back for power, balloons to pop, a score on screen, a way to start and a way to lose. How it looks, plays and sounds is your call, and that is what we care about most: a minute of play should be fun, and every shot and hit should feel and sound good. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts, and by playing it.
answers:
[goal]
Build Level 1 of a Windows 95-style archery game in [index.html](<WORKSPACE>/game/index.html) as a single self-contained file with mouse aiming, bow draw power, rising balloons, on-screen score, start/lose states, and synthesized sound effects.

[action]
- **Assumptions**:
  - Lose condition: 5 hearts (`♥♥♥♥♥`); each balloon that escapes past the top costs 1 heart, while arrows are unlimited so gameplay stays fast-paced.
  - Only Google Fonts (`Press Start 2P` and `VT323`, with `monospace` fallback) are fetched externally; all graphics are drawn on an 800x500 HTML5 `<canvas>` and all audio is synthesized via the Web Audio API.
  - High score is persisted locally in `localStorage`.
- **Implementation**:
  - Created [index.html](<WORKSPACE>/game/index.html) with a Windows 95 window frame, beveled HUD (`SCORE`, `BEST`, `POPPED`, `HEARTS`), `SFX: ON/OFF` toggle, Start dialog, and Game Over dialog.
  - Implemented mouse aiming, hold-to-draw power meter with bowstring bend and dotted trajectory preview, arrow gravity/rotation, multi-balloon skewer combos (`x2!`, `x3!`), particle bursts, floating score popups, and escalating waves.
  - Added synthesized Web Audio API sounds for bow draw, string twang, pitched balloon pops, ground thuds, missed-balloon warning, and game over.

[result]
- [index.html](<WORKSPACE>/game/index.html) is written and ready to open directly in a browser.
- Automated headless browser verification was not run because `playwright` is not installed in Node or Python in this environment.

[next]
Open [index.html](<WORKSPACE>/game/index.html) in a browser, click **START LEVEL 1**, aim with the mouse, and hold/release Left Click to shoot.
